entities.summary: William Butcher is an American professional ice hockey defenseman who currently plays for the Cleveland Monsters in the American Hockey League (AHL). Butcher was selected in the fifth round, 123rd overall, by the Colorado Avalanche in the 2013 NHL entry draft.
